avis.titre: Perfect for anyone with oily skin!
avis.texte: I bought this specifically based on the claims of helping to gently exfoliate and help control excess oil. Alot of the people with oily skin saying in the reviews that this helped to stop the excess sebum were NOT kidding. This helped my oily skin go from summer greasey to just about perfect balance now! I say try it!!
I did enjoy this toner as someone who had sensitive acne prone skin this was hydrating and it did what it needed to do . This is a good starter toner.
Love love love it! Use it every day right after I wash my face. My skin is so hydrated now!

This toner is wonderful after washing with your favorite cleanser (I truly recommend the dokdo cleanser). If you use a cotton pad to swipe it across your face, you'll see any remaining grim removed onto it. I especially use this toner after taking off my makeup to make sure that all of the product on my face is cleaned off deeply. I do wish that this toner would brighten my dark spots but maybe it's too soon to tell if it can even out my skin.
Will be re-ordering this product. Zero skin irritation for sensitive folks like myself.
I have rebought this lotion many times. It is good for my sensitive acne prone skin. I like that it is light as I have oily skin.

This product is marketed as a mild and gentle toner. I've used it both ways (as directed on the bottle), one by swiping a cotton pad (all over face it says), the other by using as a sort of essence that you pat in, but the second method burned the gentle skin around my eyes, causing it to get inflamed, itch, and flake. This never happened when using a cotton pad (I never swipe over my eyes because I don't like to drag the delicate skin around the eye). I would say that the product feels pretty good if you use it carefully. Roundlab should revise the instructions to not let you put the product "all over your face."

This has done wonders for my dry, sensitive skin. I've had zero problems using it, even over really angry eczema patches (if anything, it appears to have been helping heal them). I love that it doesn't leave any residue or weird texture after it absorbs, but my skins feels noticeably more hydrated. My pores are less noticeable after having used this toner for a couple months.
The dokdo toner is very nice, great for layering, and really hydrating my skin. A bit smaller than I was thinking based on how much I spent. Overall worth buying again tho.

I really like this toner, it hydrates super well, and after a lazy day or week of skipping skincare... you can literally FEEL the toner absorbing, and it feels so refreshing and hydrating, it also gives a nice glow, but im more of a matte girl so after skincare I use matte pads. I really like this product! Super hydrating, and I definitely see how it's been benefiting my slightly textured skin.
I bought this and it is AMAZING! My oil is so well controlled and my dry sensitive skin loves it. I 11/10 recommend.

avis.titre: Good toner, I like the mugwort better
avis.texte: I got this as a sample when buying other products. It is nice and I could see it being helpful for people with really reactive or sensitive skin. I prefer the mugwort tone for my red acne prone skin.

This toner is great for an extra boost to my skin routine. Makes my skin feel hydrated but not overly saturated as I go to apply my next product. Highly recommend as a good basic all purpose skin toner.

I cannot live without this toner. I started using it when I lived in Korea, and I'm a life long customer. My skin drinks this up. I have sensitive skin, and this toner calms and moisturizes without any irritation.
I got to try a 50 ml sample of this product. I liked it for my sensitive skin. I use the pine calming line and have never tried the dodoko line. I used it to make my own toner pads.
This deep sea water really is amazing! Satisfying results from my skin after just two weeks. Significantly clearer complexion, smaller and unclogged pores, all day moisture- i just love this toner.
This toner will not dry out your skin with a bunch of alcohol- it's light and refreshing.
Love love the toner. I have dry and sensitive skin and was so afraid to try a new product. But this toner is a winner. Lightweight and hydrating.
Holy grail, ive been using this for 2 years and I just always restock. Hydrating and great to use year round
It was fine in the summer but during winter I get rocesa. It made me have red itchy dry patches.
Amazing. Leaves a little white residue for like 20 seconds but other that, works great on my skin and pairs well with the toner and face wash!
This is my go to face toner, I always introduce the product to my friends
The dokdo toner feels refreshing on my skin, no irritations or burns. My skin feels calm after I use it.
This is an absolute staple in the skin routine,love it!! It has a water texture and doesn't leave skin sticky if you use a few drops to many and you can see and feel the hydration take place!!
I love this toner, so hydrating, easy absorption and affordable. Great value!

I love the texture of their sunscreen and toner; they're very light and not greasy at all. I usually use the toner as a second cleanse, wiping my skin with a cotton pad afterward. It leaves my skin glowing. I highly recommend it.

I'm not someone that washes their face in the morning (unless I wake up sweating). I typically either use a toner or a rose water to freshen up my face and go on about my skin care routine I recently purchased this toner and IM OBSESSED. Leaves my skin feeling so smooth and soft and fresh. Will definitely be buying again in the future and definitely recommend to everyone to try!
I've been using this for almost a year, and i never changer. It's so light and non-irritating, holds moisture during summer adequately, combined with birch moisturizing cream. Love it!
Not only does it remove what your cleanser missed it heals and makes your skin feel so soft and really refreshed. Get rids of dead skin cells allows your skin to breath again.
It didnt improve my skin or worsen my skin. And for refrence i have oily/combination, acne-prone skin.
I really like this toner! The sample made me want the cleanser and moisturizer too!
I love all of round labs products but this is by far my favorite toner ever.
Started using this and I love it. I will probably use this toner from now on!

Watery formula. Non-scented. Extremely hydrating with no sticky residue. Perfect for applying multiple layers and using as DIY sheet mask. Goes well with all my other skincare products. I love using it a spray bottle to mist my face. I think this is great for all skin types.
It's very light on my skin and hydrates well. It doesn't irritate so I love using it every day after cleansing.
So far it's good it's my first time trying it and it's an awesome product it leave my face feeling nice and refresh.👍�👍�👍�👍�

I combine this with the birch water toner and my sensitive skin has never been smoother!!!! Really love this stuff!!

avis.titre: The Best Toner I have Ever Tried!
avis.texte: Absolutely love this toner! It was a game changer for me. Cleared break outs and evened out my skintone. Would recommend slowly building up use of this toner, I use it 2-3 times a week.

I absolutely love this product. My skin looks great and feels great. I have mature skin that is highly sensitive, but this product has made my skin glow. Yes I highly recommend this product. Just get it you won't be disappointed.
I was looking for excellent toner and this is that one, which is so refreshing my skin.

I used a lot of different toners when experimenting with skincare but I always end up going back to the 1025 Dokdo Toner. Its super light and non irritating and you always feel refreshed when using it. A hack is to put it in a small mist bottle and just spray it over your face when you need to use it!
It's very cooling and easy on my skin (which is irritable usually) I have been using it for two weeks and i have not had an break outs either.

Love this toner! It feels like water on the skin but so hydrating. I live in Hawaii and its hard to find products that dont just sit on top of the skin and feel sticky. This is super refreshing and the large size is super economical. My skin is sensitive to fragrance and I love that this is unscented. I would recommend this toner to anyone!

Incredibly light and watery, absorbs quickly, unscented and hyper effective. well priced for what you get and very comfortable to apply! use a cotton pad and swipe over my face and have been so pleased with the smoothing of the texture just in the 5 days I have been using it! Incredible product and happy it's so reasonably priced! Super cute packaging too im obsessed now.

This dokdo cleanser is fantastic. It is very mild feeling but has noticeably improved skin texture just in the 3 days of twice daily usage, when coupled with the birch moisturizing cream (incredible) and the dokdo cleanser (also incredible). Super watery, light so it goes on easily and absorbs quickly as well. Could not recommend enough and is a great value for performance.
Love this as a gentle everyday toner to soothe my skin and help heal acne
This does a great job of leaving my face feeling refreshed and has not aggravated my sensitive skin.

There has never been a toner that I liked. They all make my skin feel dry and tight. The Dokdo Toner is something different. My skin feels fresh and hydrated. I love starting my routine with Dokdo Toner.
I love this toner and the peeling gel is gentle and works well.
Love the feel on skin, really light weight and gives that glow 😍😍

I like how this toner is made without artificial dyes or perfumes leaving no smell at. It's very moisturizing and leaves my skin feeling clean and fresh with no sticky oily residue. My skin feels hydrated after 2 days of using. I will be purchasing this again although it is a little bit pricey for a small bottle.

I find 1025 Dokdo Toner really does what it promises. Even after cleansing my face, I see 1025 Dokdo Toner really gets into my pores and see the results on the cotton pad. It isn't harsh but very refreshing and hydrated.

I was gifted a 100ml bottle of this toner, and normally I don't use toner as I find my skin doesn't care if I use it or not. I ended up using the whole bottle because it was easy to use in my routine. After I ran out of it, I didn't replace it for three weeks and during the time that I wasnt using it (even with changing nothing else) my skin was so much worse. I immediately hopped online and bought the 500ml bottle and my skin is finally happy again! No more sensitivity, redness, or flaking. I think I'll probably use this toner forever after seeing how angry my skin got from not using it for a few weeks.
It works well on my skin (tends to be more dry than oily). I love that it doesn't really have a scent. It's moisturizing without being irritating.
Love this toner! It makes my skin feel clean and moisturized ❤️
Love these products and the samples with each order is wonderful too.
Right now, the toner has been really good! It get used to mi skin quickly and leaves my sling refreshed and hydrated
Always wonderful. We never let ourselves run out. Perfect for hypersensitive, reactive, dry, or oily skin. I have all of those - very complicated skin. This is a game changer.
So light on the skin and locks in hydration really well! Definitely getting this again.
Makes my skin feel smooth and hydrated. 10/10 would 100% recommend
First night using the Dokdo toner. Feels very nice and hydrating and not sticky and no bad reaction so far.
came in perfect condition, and came pretty early. i ordered around sunday (december 8th), and it arrived a week later
This feels great on my skin without over drying. Great product and great value!

Using toners in the past never did much for me, but THIS toner has changed my perspective. Thank you for making such wonderful product for my aging skin.

I've been using this for a few days, and my husband came home yesterday and thought I had makeup on. This sounds crazy, but I swear on my life, I noticed instant changes in my skin. It appears smoother, softer, more moisturized, and it just kind of looks like I have tinted moisturizer on all the time. What in the sorcery is going on? Update: it has completely cleared my skin, and kept it moisturized. I press it into my skin before serums and moisturizer!
My favorite skin care line! Forever loyal for the consistent results!! 💙
This toner is (feminine) This toner is wonderful. It doesn't sting my delicate skin. My skin feels fresh and very soft.
I have oily, acne prone and textured skin and my skin loved this, it's hydrating, doesn't make you look greasy and I've noticed some improvement with my closed comedones

I love this line of skin care. The toner is particularly just what my skin needed after cleansing. The rest of the products go on so smoothly after toning, I would like if it came in a spray bottle with a little scent.
This product is amazing. It leaves my skin so soft and no residue after usage. My skin has been brighter since starting this toner. It's my new go-to!
Along with 1025 Dokdo Cleansing Gel, I'm really appreciating this unscented, deepsea-water toner. After using this my face feels fresh and leaves me feeling more confident.
Absolutely love this toner. perfect for my sensitive skin & leaves me hydrated!
Feels great on my skin and doesn't make break despite having acne prone skin
When this and the birch juice moisturizer are paired is a game changer and will really give your skin that perfect hydration and glow.
Amazing toner! My skin feels hydrated and fresh! My new go to fav!
Leaves some redness on my skin but this was only during the initial use. I have seen a difference in skin however will continue to use it along with the Face cleanser.

avis.titre: Super Refreshing and Helped with Texture
avis.texte: Oily in T-Zone but normal skin. Smell is very minimal. Light weight feels like water but did help with the texture I have on my forehead. Would definitely recommend giving it a try.
This product worked well with me. Super light weight but helped with the small texture I have on my forehead. Would definitely recommend.
I really enjoy this toner. My skin feels refreshed after using this gentle product. I plan to re-purchase once I run out. Would recommend to a friend!
Just one of the best Toners out there. I have such sensitive skin, & this toner works so well with my rosacea. It's just such a great balance.
Love the product. So light and airy. It is so refreshing. I recommend to add multiple layers.
It's so refreshing against my skin and you don't need a lot. I would recommend

avis.titre: A new staple in my skincare
avis.texte: This toner is so light, that it's deceiving. It sinks right into my skin immediately and helps provide long lasting hydration without making me feel greasy. It's great! I honestly feel like it has helped brighten my skin in the 5 months I've been using it and it surprised me how much I liked it.

avis.titre: Safe & calming for my sensitive & acne prone skin
avis.texte: It is very effective at calming my sensitive and red skin. I usually drench a few cotton pads with the toner and leave them on my cheeks for ~10minutes My skin temperature cools down and stayed hydrated.

avis.titre: Loved it for a long while
avis.texte: I love this toner for a very long time but after some time, I felt my skin got so used to it and it stopped helping it. I do recommend it as a beginner toner, it's very nice for my sensitive skin!

I have very very sensitive skin. I have Rosacea, Eczema and acne prone skin. My skin is extremely sensitive. This tiner does not irritate my skin at all. It is very gentle. I saw results after using it only a handful of times. Its amazing. I can't wait to try the other products.

Love this toner! It makes my skin so bright and feel so smooth and soft. Very moisturizing! My only complaint is that the bigger size is super expensive 🥲 but if that's not a concern for you, buy the bigger size! worth it!!
This toner works well with my sensitive and mature skin. It helps exfoliate the dead skin cells but does not dry out my skin. This size bottle works great for travel.

I've been using this toner for the past 2 years. It's very gentle and doesn't irritate the skin. Both of our skins cleared up after switching to this toner and we have acne prone oily skin that is now comb skin. Would recommend to people with similar ski type.

I really love this toner. It layers on well and it absorbs well. It's sticky for the first few seconds/min but it absorbs well with no stickiness whatsoever. It also leaves a refreshing feel, without drying my skin. I had no flakiness. It's hydrating, but you'll need something else to layer on to maintain the hydration.
I have sensitive skin and redness, I love this toner. The toner has no scent and is watery like. Soft exfoliation for sensitive skin folks.
